limitations: Host arrival uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC_NS; it is not silently substituted for vehicle time.
Only message fields classified as timestamps by the frozen static catalog are sampled as onboard time carriers.
Request-window observation can be periodic/default traffic; baseline_present and observation_causality retain this ambiguity.
No flight or property-conformance scenario was executed; this is runtime support and parameter evidence only.
pymavlink setup_logfile/setup_logfile_raw produced zero-byte auxiliary files; messages.jsonl is the authoritative nonempty traffic capture.

phases.name: STARTUP
phases.notes: Stable target is defined by receiving the expected vehicle HEARTBEAT, then observing a three-second passive warmup.
phases.traffic_origin: Passive UDP receive only; no PARAM or MAV_CMD request was sent.

phases.name: BASELINE
phases.notes: This phase is measured after target HEARTBEAT and passive warmup. It is kept separate so later request responses are not classified as default streams.
phases.traffic_origin: Passive firmware-default stream only; no outbound request and no harness heartbeat.

phases.name: PARAMETER_DOWNLOAD
phases.notes: Full runtime parameter enumeration. Source defaults are never substituted.
phases.traffic_origin: Harness GCS HEARTBEAT plus PARAM_REQUEST_LIST/PARAM_REQUEST_READ; no PARAM_SET.

phases.name: REQUEST_SWEEP
phases.notes: ACK and message observation are recorded independently. A message seen in the request window is not claimed causal when it was already a baseline stream.
phases.traffic_origin: One serial MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE (command 512) per frozen all.xml message ID.

phases.name: RELEVANT_STREAM_SAMPLE
phases.notes: This phase follows and is excluded from the passive baseline and request sweep.
phases.traffic_origin: MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL for selected AP-observation messages, then timed receive.

traffic_capture.startup_bad_data_interpretation: Plain-text ArduPilot serial boot banner before MAVLink framing, retained as BAD_DATA bytes in decoded JSONL.

older_or_inapplicable_requested_names.ARMING_CHECK: ARMING_REQUIRE plus ARMING_SKIPCHK in this revision
